projectDescription: A modded Google Colab notebook that lets you run KoboldCpp — a local LLM inference engine — in the cloud with GPU acceleration, supporting text, vision, image generation, speech, TTS, music, and embeddings models.
keyFeatures: One-click GPU-accelerated LLM inference in Google Colab
Preset model templates for general, roleplay, instruct, corporate, and image use cases
Custom GGUF model loading via HuggingFace URLs
Vision/multimodal model support with mmproj files
Image generation (Stable Diffusion, FLUX) via sd.cpp backend
Cloudflare tunnel for remote access to the KoboldCpp API
Mobile keep-alive audio cell to prevent session timeout
publicApiSurface: LoadTextModel checkbox — enables text LLM loading
Model URL field — custom GGUF model from HuggingFace
LoadVisionMMProjector checkbox + Mmproj URL — vision multimodal projector
LoadImgModel checkbox + ImgModel/ImgClip1/ImgVAE — image generation model
LoadSpeechModel checkbox + SpeechModel URL — Whisper speech-to-text
LoadMusicModel / LoadFastMusicModel / LoadMusicXLModel checkboxes — music generation
Layers dropdown — GPU layer count (Auto or 999)
ContextSize dropdown — context window size (4096–65536 tokens)
Multiplayer checkbox — enable multiplayer session sharing
AllowSaveToGoogleDrive checkbox — Google Drive story persistence
MakeLocalTunnelFallback checkbox — localtunnel fallback when Cloudflare fails
DeleteExistingModels checkbox — clears cached GGUF files on restart
Cloudflare remotetunnel — public HTTPS URL to KoboldCpp web UI and API
